crossRefs.note: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
Blessed are you by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.
Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.
Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared…

translations.web: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
translations.bsb: Surely those He blesses will inherit the land, but the cursed will be destroyed.
translations.kjv: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
translations.asv: For such as are blessed of him shall inherit the land; And they that are cursed of him shall be cut off.
